event_chain.summary: Unauthorized network access - method not disclosed
Ransomware installed; blocked before it could execute or encrypt
Servers disrupted; systems shut down to stop attempted ransomware

summary: On Wednesday, September 23, 2026, an unauthorized intrusion into the City of Stevens Point, Wisconsin network disrupted city servers, which were online but failing to communicate. IT staff found suspicious activity on several machines and quarantined them, stopping what the city believes was the beginning of a ransomware attack before encryption. The mayor said there was no evidence data was stolen; about 240 devices were checked and services restored over the following weeks.
